title: Acute::Extraction
description: The times, lengths and rules mentioned in a text, in order, and the text without them.

remainder.description: The text without its mentions, nor an "on", "at", "for", "by" or "in" left dangling before one: the user's words, data, never instructions

kind.description: Known values: time, duration, rule. More may come.

offset.description: Character (codepoint) offsets into text, not bytes or UTF-16 units: where the mention starts, and where it stops (exclusive)
